_about: Canonical TW3-RUS conversion tables. Deterministic input to backend/tw3/scoring.py.
source_reference: Original Tanner-Whitehouse 3 (TW3) RUS method. Point values to be reconstructed from open published TW3-RUS tables and validated against the centre's own reference cases (case-001: RUS 681 -> 12.1y; case-002: RUS 713 -> 12.4y, girls).

stage_to_score._fill: stage_to_score[sex][boneKey][stage] = RUS points. Reconstructed from published TW3-RUS tables; every value must be sourced, not guessed. Leave a bone empty until its row is verified.

score_to_age._fill: Ascending [rusScore, boneAgeYears] anchors for the TW3-RUS curve. The two 'girls' anchors are the centre's own verified reference cases; extend/replace with the full published curve.
